SMDR_reproduction.scope: Reuses published SMDR library and archived fit couplings; new minimization and direct matching check, not an independent beta-function calculation.

EW_is_false_near_degenerate_vacuum.gap: supplied condition; no mechanism derives its magnitude
EW_is_false_near_degenerate_vacuum.precision: Finite-order SM running cannot resolve a ~1e-120 quartic splitting
EW_is_false_near_degenerate_vacuum.relation: V_EW - V_true = rho_Lambda,obs; near-critical equality rather than absolute stability

EW_is_true_final_vacuum.relation: Mt <= Mt_critical, within the declared theoretical approximation
EW_is_true_final_vacuum.vacuum_density: zero plus transient corrections; retains the failure to produce observed positive dark energy

MPP_coexistence.status: Additional Froggatt-Nielsen assumption; not implied by q dynamics

conditions: One shared mu; minimally coupled, q-independent matter; chosen stable q branch
P_q matched to a specified true final vacuum, rather than independently to each phase
SM Higgs potential describes all relevant competing vacua up to the stated Planck cutoff
No relevant new thresholds or unsupplied higher-dimensional operators; conventional flat-space SM stability proxy
Small present vacuum gap is separately demanded; the action does not select that gap

future_use.covariance: Use the full joint covariance or likelihood; gradient is (1,-dMt_dMh,-dMt_dalpha_s)
future_use.decision: A discrepancy concerns the named conditional SM/final-vacuum hypothesis. A 5-sigma flag under the illustrative Gaussian model requires a separately justified likelihood; no fixed future significance is forecast.
future_use.eligible_data_rule: Only data unobserved by this analysis when this version was published; no retrospective reclassification
future_use.measurement: First subsequently published qualifying e+e- top-threshold joint mass and alpha_s likelihood, with Higgs input and theory/mass-scheme treatment stated
future_use.primary_mass: Short-distance mass consistently matched to MSbar couplings; never silently identify a Monte Carlo mass with a pole mass
future_use.revision_rule: New physics, matching or criterion changes require a new version; retain this version and report both.
future_use.support: Agreement also supports ordinary SM stability and cannot uniquely support GRUT

local_use_box.outside_box: Run the recorded RG criterion, not an extrapolation of this line.

operational_RG_proxy: min lambda_MSbar(Q) = 0 for 1e8 GeV <= Q <= 1.2209e19 GeV; V=lambda*h^4/4
status: Conditional relation recorded after exposure to all checkpoint data; not a new or GRUT-specific prediction
